Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5867); an Elamite or Persian:--Elamite.
BiblicalUsage: Elamítēs means Elamite. In Acts 2:9, the text says "and Elamites."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, elamítēs means Elamite, and I leave it at that.
